map.name: Glassworks Relay
map.description: A precision trial through four enemy formations in a derelict factory.

text.objectives: Clear four escalating bays while preserving your interceptor.
briefing: Control the starting combat unit and travel through the four linked bays.
Each enemy formation must be eliminated before the next bay activates.
Every clear awards its listed ore reward; losing your unit or running out of time ends the trial.

messages.start: The first formation is active. Keep your interceptor moving.
messages.timeout: The relay timed out before the final bay.

waves.clear_message: Bay 1 clear. +18 ore; the missile screen advances.
Bay 2 clear. +24 ore; the ranged pack advances.
Bay 3 clear. +32 ore; the heavy line advances.
Final bay clear. +45 ore; certification complete.
